data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Map search, enter origin, set search type and flexible dates, search), but it leaves the search type and flexible dates steps optional and vague. It also names the parameter "dates" instead of flexible_dates, omits opening the BOOK tab, and has no concrete values for the options, so an automation would have to guess at several choices.
